champion.tips: KARMA TIPS AND TRICKS Aim your Q so it hits the enemy and the minion wave together so it pushes the minion wave and pokes the enemy at the same time. In team fights, use your empowered E rather than your empowered Q as the shield is more valuable in a team fight. Try and poke the enemy down as much as possible with your Q in the early game. Use your level 1 ability advantage to get a lot of damage down early.
champion.builds: THE BEST KARMA BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR MID IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Karma Mid build, you should take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Arcane Comet as your keystone, followed by Manaflow Band, Absolute Focus and Scorch in the primary tree, as well as Sixth Sense and Ultimate Hunter in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Ability Haste in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Malignance as your first item, followed by Ionian Boots of Lucidity and Horizon Focus. For your last 3 items, you should build Cosmic Drive, Rabadon's Deathcap and finish with Cryptbloom. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 52.1% winrate over 802 matches played. Optional Your second option for Karma Mid build would be to take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Summon Aery as your keystone, Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Gathering Storm in the primary tree, and Font of Life with Revitalize in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Ability Haste in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense. The items for the build are Malignance, which you should build first, followed by Ionian Boots of Lucidity as your second item and Horizon Focus as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Cosmic Drive, Rabadon's Deathcap and Moonstone Renewer. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 50.5% win rate over 216 matches. Situational Karma Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Karma build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Karma runes page.
